title: Ronnie Lazaro receives Galardón de Honor at 25th PELÍCULA>PELIKULA Festival
summary: Veteran actor Ronnie Lazaro received the Galardón de Honor during the opening of the 25th edition of PELÍCULA>PELIKULA, the Manila Spanish Film Festival, in Makati City on Friday.
